annotations.annotation_text: Page 204 opens Book 1, Chapter 8 ("Anna Livia Plurabelle") during the Age of Gods (closing) phase. This passage continues the two washerwomen gossiping on opposite banks of the darkening Liffey, 500+ river names woven into the text, metamorphosis into elm and stone, featuring ALP, the two washerwomen. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
